name: Kamishiro Tabito
source:
A genius gamer who makes a fortune in virtual currency by playing the VR racing game "SkyOut Forever".

He manages to go toe-to-toe with corporate teams even though he's only a high school student, and is always vying for the top.

He is cool, calm, and confident, but he hates large gatherings of people.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983260/LUNARiA_Virtualized_Moonchild/]Steam[/url]]
